coupling: The first commit changes eo from an absolute REG_STARTEND end offset into the checked window length and passes it directly to pcre2_match. The later validation commit makes the match length an explicit eo - so calculation, interpreting eo as an absolute end again. Both changes are safe in isolation: the first passes the relative length directly, and the second subtracts from the original absolute end. Together, a valid range whose start exceeds its width underflows PCRE2_SIZE and makes the matcher read beyond the bounded subject. A fix must make the range representation and its consumer agree across both commits; changing only the raw offset validation leaves this valid range reachable.
